MERCURY_COUNT.text: All flight controllers, we are picking up the count at T minus fifteen.
Booster: oxygen topping, all pressures normal.
Network: Bermuda and the range radars are up and tracking the balloon.
Retro, Recovery: give me the recovery area.
Pad: gantry is back. Pad is clear.
Recovery: the forces are standing by.
All flight controllers, final status check.
Booster: one minute. Everything in the band.

ORBIT_SIMS.nominal: A clean flight to orbit and home. Nothing was wrong.
ORBIT_SIMS.guidance: An Atlas guidance failure: she went off her line.
ORBIT_SIMS.shortburn: An Atlas sustainer that cut off early, short of orbit.
ORBIT_SIMS.seg51loose: Segment 51 lit, and the heat shield really was loose.
ORBIT_SIMS.seg51false: Segment 51 lit, but it was a bad switch: the shield was tight.
ORBIT_SIMS.scanner: A bad horizon scanner: the automatic system held the wrong attitude and burned fuel.
ORBIT_SIMS.seastate: The sea in the recovery area was above state 4.

guidance: On the tape the flight-path angle walks off the planned line, steadily, in one direction.
Convair's readout of the Atlas autopilot shows the programmer stepping late.
shortburn: The sustainer stopped early, its chamber pressure falling away over a second or two.
The velocity on the tape stops short of what orbit needs.
nominal: Every channel on the Atlas tape stays in its band from liftoff to cutoff.

ORBIT_UNITS.carrier: The carrier, with its helicopters, on the planned splashdown point north of Grand Turk
ORBIT_UNITS.uprange: The destroyer 300 km uprange of the planned point
ORBIT_UNITS.downrange: The destroyer 300 km downrange of the planned point

PACK_OPTIONS.keep: Leave the retro pack on through entry. Its straps would hold a loose shield against the capsule until the air does.
PACK_OPTIONS.jettison: Jettison the retro pack as planned. A strapped-on pack burning off in entry could damage a good shield.

PAD_OPTIONS.wait: Leave her overnight. By morning the batteries will have run down and the oxygen boiled off, and the pad crew can safe her.
PAD_OPTIONS.now: Send the pad crew out now to safe the capsule and drain the booster.
PAD_OPTIONS.shoot: Have the range shoot holes in the tanks with a rifle and drain her.

bag.name: Landing-bag drop test
bag.what: The capsule is dropped onto the water tank with the bag deployed, and the latch loads are traced.
bag.good: Every latch load stays in its band through the drop.
bag.bad: One latch trace drops to nothing halfway through the drop, then comes back.

horizon.name: Heated-horizon scanner test
horizon.what: Each scanner is swept across a heated horizon target and its attitude output traced.
horizon.good: Both scanners track the target to within a degree.
horizon.bad: One scanner's trace wanders more than twenty degrees off the target before it settles.

chutes.name: Parachute drop
chutes.what: A boilerplate capsule is dropped from a C-130 and the drogue and main traced.
chutes.good: Drogue and main open on time and the loads stay in their bands.

tower.name: Escape tower firing
tower.what: An escape tower fires a boilerplate capsule off a stand.
tower.good: The tower pulls clean and the capsule separates on time.

RETRO_OPTIONS.auto: Retrofire on the automatic system, holding the attitude the scanners give it.
RETRO_OPTIONS.manual: Have him fire by hand, lined up on the horizon through his window. Late by a second or two, and it costs fuel.

SIMS.nominal: A clean flight. Nothing was wrong.
SIMS.control: A control failure: the autopilot drifted and took her off her line.
SIMS.lox: An oxygen leak: the engine cut off early and she fell short.
SIMS.thrust: An over-thrust: she ran hot and fast, and ran dry early.
SIMS.radar: A radar dropout: the radar's impact point was off by a long way.
SIMS.seastate: The sea in the recovery area was above state 4.
SIMS.offstation: One of the destroyers was not on station.

plug: The engine lit and shut down within a second. The booster rose about four inches and settled back on its pad.
The cutoff signal came at the instant the tail plug pulled out of the booster.
The escape tower fired away on its own, and the capsule put its parachutes out on top of the rocket.
control: On the tape the flight-path angle walks off the planned line, steadily, in one direction.
Marshall's readout of the autopilot shows one pitch gyro drifting.
lox: The engine stopped early, the chamber pressure falling away over a second or two.
The oxygen inlet pressure sags in the seconds before the cutoff.
thrust: The velocity ran above the planned line all the way up, and the engine ran dry at 137 seconds.
The thrust controller's channel sits pinned at its limit from early in the burn.
nominal: Every booster channel on the tape stays in its band from liftoff to cutoff.
